name: venice
description: Venice AI gateway — Rust API + Next.js app with an 8-bit console (eleven display modes, light and dark). Bring your own key, or pay per request (x402) and we fund the call with our backend key. Wallet (mod protocol) auth.

/key.docs: Store caller's BYOK Venice key (Bearer token)

/chat.docs: Chat completion — BYOK or x402-paid (Bearer token)

/agent.docs: Multimodal agent turn — SSE status/media/message events (Bearer token)

/media.docs: Upload an attachment (base64/data URL) for the agent (Bearer token)

/media/:id.docs: Fetch stored media by capability id (public, unguessable)
